name: Pure ~Pure~
source:
Main character receives a huge heritage after parents death. He finds a strange girl Yurika in the basement. Girl does not remember anything, and protagonist decides to keep her at his place for the time being.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-july-2001-cosmos-no-sora-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
父母去世后，主角继承了巨额遗产。他在地下室发现了一名奇怪的少女由里香。少女什么都不记得，于是主角决定暂时让她住在自己家里。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-july-2001-cosmos-no-sora-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
